title: How to restart the service on watch
symptom: After turning off and on the watch, xDrip does not work as a standalone collector; the user cannot restart the service and only disabling and re-enabling the smartwatch from the phone works.
evidence_quote: I'm not able to re-start the service, I tried every option. The only way is to disable and re-enable the smartwatch from xdrip installed on the phone I used to configure it.
